description:
Sticky Notes Plus is a fork of Notes by Maoschanz (https://github.com/maoschanz/notes-extension-gnome): sticky notes for the GNOME Shell desktop, extended with:
* Multi-monitor layouts: every monitor configuration gets its own saved arrangement of the notes, restored automatically when that configuration is back
* A color filter: show only the notes of the chosen color; the active filter is marked with a dot on the panel icon
* Undo and redo for the text of every note
* A text context menu and complete keyboard shortcuts: cut, copy, paste, select all, undo, redo, both in the editing mode and on read-only notes
* Double-click the header of a note to unfold it so the whole text is visible, and double-click again to fold it back
* Create a new note from the clipboard content, and paste into notes; the clipboard is accessed only on explicit user actions
* Fully localized, including a complete Russian translation

The frozen package for GNOME Shell 42-44 is not distributed on extensions.gnome.org: download notes@escator.zip from the Git repository (https://github.com/escator/notes-extension-gnome).
name: Sticky Notes Plus
